name: chiral abiogenesis

phase_0.boundary_condition: The lipid vesicle membrane that confines the prebiotic soup and isolates the chiral amplification from the external environment.

VINIT.justification: The void before catalytic cycles begin, containing only achiral building blocks.

TANCH.justification: The lipid seal that bounds the reaction space and defines the internal chemical regime.

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism driving L chain growth and stereoselective replication.

AREV.justification: The reverse morphism of D chain decay and stereochemical back reaction.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of monomers into extended functional macromolecules.

IMSCRIB.justification: The chiral polymer recognizing its own mirror incompatible geometry to enable exact copying.

FSPLIT.justification: The external chiral bias that splits the racemic B state into distinct L and D arms.

FFUSE.justification: The fusion of L and D phase information into a unified functional biopolymer matrix.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative evaluation state where L pathway functional folding succeeds.

EVALF.justification: The negative evaluation state where D enantiomers become a stereochemical dead end.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradoxical B state where L and D enantiomers coexist in perfect unbroken symmetry.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible ROM storage of L chirality in living polymers.

phase_3.void_description: Pre catalytic chemical vacuum devoid of chiral information or metabolic cycles.
phase_3.true_description: L enantiomeric excess enabling functional homochiral polymer folding.
phase_3.false_description: D enantiomeric trap causing stereochemical dead ends and racemic poisoning.
phase_3.both_description: Racemic paradox where L and D enantiomers mutually inhibit each other in perfect equilibrium.

Chiral topological reintegration, fusion of L and D phase information into a unified functional biopolymer network
Homochiral macromolecular fixation, irreversible ROM storage of L chirality in living polymers

phase_5.memory_mechanism: Chiral memory encoded in polymer backbone torsion angles.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Thermodynamic gradients and autocatalytic feedback loops.
phase_5.alfs_store: The universal prebiotic monomer inventory and geochemical baseline.
